keyPhrases.text: positively thrums with life and love
mighty play full of magic and poetry
almost bursting with joy and celebration
shake up the Broadway season with tornado-like force

reasoning: This is an unequivocal rave review filled with superlatives and effusive praise. The critic uses powerful positive language throughout ('gloriously entertaining,' 'mighty play,' 'tornado-like force') with no meaningful criticisms. The review celebrates every aspect from writing to direction to performances to design, positioning it as a must-see theatrical event.
